scope: Read-only production transaction; local code and archived evidence audit. No ingestion, deployment or production mutation.
strictValidation: assertIdentityReview on latest SourceIdentityReview for each source, at snapshot time
jobCounting: Each active Job counted once; active JobSource intersected with Source.status=ACTIVE; four disjoint certification buckets.
limits: 45 valid records validate the recorded artifact and contract; semantic correctness of all archived official pages not re-reviewed individually.
337 sources without a portal review or reviewed employer alias in DB may have research pages in archives; absence of a DB review is not proof of absence of research.
Per-source and partial-evidence job counts overlap; only the four global buckets are additive.
No claim that uncertified sources or active jobs on paused sources are necessarily wrong.
